single_hypothesis: Reading each token's m contiguous GM streams with ONE DMA (backward grouped path, R=1 keeps every replica slice contiguous and 16-aligned in UB) cuts per-token MTE command count from m+1 to 2, improving mid-shape backward wall time and DMA efficiency.
changed_mechanism: tiling struct: bwdGrouped flag added in the former 4-byte padding slot; ABI stays 40 bytes
host: grouped enabled when backward && tilesPerRow==1 && d%16==0 && (2*m*D*2B + acc + out + BF16 staging) <= platform-queried UB size; rowBlock forced to 1; all other tiling policy unchanged

kernel: new ProcessBackwardGrouped - one DataCopy of m*D elements per token into a ping-pong slot (slot size m*D), Cast replica 0 then Axpy/Add replicas 1..m-1 on contiguous [k*D] offsets, single-row output write; same event protocol as E5; ungrouped path kept verbatim as fallback (non-aligned D, D>8192, or UB too small e.g. large m=8 D=7168)
unchanged_mechanisms: entire forward path (kernel objects byte-identical region, simulator 0.0%)
FP32 accumulation order and final cast semantics
E4 compile-time direction specialization and 4-kernel key layout

preceding_study.load_balance_refuted: R=1 vs R=2 study on S=1024 D=4096 m=4 (48 cores): backward R=2 beat R=1 by 32% (per-task overhead dominates), so pure load-balance host change was cancelled; forward R=1 only -3.3%
preceding_study.motivation: backward R=2 sim wall 11.04us vs forward same traffic 8.62us: the m+1 fragmented reads per token are the overhead; grouping addresses the root cause

validation.actual_kernel: 7 CA-simulator cases clean: mid grouped vs ungrouped A/B (48 cores), small grouped FP16/BF16, m8 grouped, D=17 ungrouped fallback, forward small
validation.correctness_argument: identical arithmetic per replica (Cast/Axpy/Add on contiguous k*D offsets equal the 2D-DMA-gathered layout of the ungrouped path because rowBlock==1); grouped read offset task*m*D matches the [S,m,D] GM layout exactly; alignment guaranteed by d%16==0 precondition

simulator.interpretation: Wall -5.3% on the mid backward shape with better core balance despite +36% total cycles (finer tasks); small backward instructions drop another 21% on top of E5. Large m=8 D=7168 backward does NOT fit grouped (301KB > UB) and keeps the current path.

limitations: Grouped path inapplicable to the largest backward shapes (UB), so points mapped to those stay on the old path
Point 2/4 direction and exact shape unknown; -5.3% sim wall only translates to score if they are grouped-eligible backward mids
Single platform observation will sit inside the +-1.2 noise band unless DMA efficiency gains are larger on real hardware
failure_analysis: All grouped-eligible backward points (4,5,8) hit Time Limit Exceeded with 100% error; non-grouped paths (forward 1/2/3, non-eligible backward 6/7) passed with E5-level times. Root cause lives in ProcessBackwardGrouped real-HW behavior (candidates: count-form DataCopy shape, or back-to-back MTE2_V set/wait with empty MTE2 queue / no prefetch). CA simulator executed the same path cleanly - simulator blind spot #2. Rules E4: non-Pass scores voided, recomputed from next passing submission.
